title: senecio rhopalophyllus
intro: Senecio rhopalophyllus, commonly known as Woolly Groundsel, is a plant species in the daisy family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Senecio rhopalophyllus include its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, making it a potential remedy for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Senecio rhopalophyllus include sesquiterpene lactones, phenolic compounds, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
